name: Falcon 9 Block 5 | CSG-3
description: CSG-3 is an Earth observation satellite for the Italian Space Agency, part of a reconnaissance constellation using synthetic aperture radars operating in the X-band.

landing.description: The Falcon 9 first stage B1081 has landed on Landing Zone 4 after its 21st flight.
